open-questions.question: Is the Collection Agent a new list of agents, or should the field reuse an existing table such as Salesperson/Purchaser? Reusing an existing table removes the new table, page and permissions and changes every field's type and length to match its key.
Are collection agents named persons (employees or external collectors)? If so, the agent name is personal data and needs EndUserIdentifiableInformation rather than CustomerContent.
May users change the agent on an open reminder or finance charge memo, or must it always equal the customer's agent? What happens to open documents when the customer's agent changes?

Does 'show the agent' include the printed or emailed reminder and finance charge memo reports, or only the pages? Printed output would need report extensions and layout selection, which are not designed.
Must users filter or see the agent as a column on Customer Ledger Entries? The design stores the field on Cust. Ledger Entry for that reason; if not, a related table keyed by Entry No. is preferred.
Should G/L entries created by issuing also carry the agent? Not designed; the journal-line field would allow it.

Do 'each agent's collections' also include payments and sales invoices for the customer? Only entries created by issuing reminders and finance charge memos are designed; payments and sales postings would need their own hops.
Must existing customers, open reminders or already issued documents and entries receive an agent when the app is installed or upgraded? No install or upgrade step is designed.
Is the agent needed only on headers, or also on reminder and finance charge memo lines? Only headers are designed.
